title: Canon text-property encoding may scan and send beyond its stack buffer
summary: Severity medium; confidence high; length/termination. indigo_drivers/ccd_ptp/indigo_ptp_canon.c:1534-1540 copies256 characters with strncpy into a256-byte payload without forcing NUL, then strlen derives the transfer length. The caller1545-1547 passes the framework text item's value, whose capacity is larger than256; a valid long text property is sufficient to lose termination. This can overread stack bytes and use that inflated length for the USB/ICA outgoing copy. Minimal fix: reject an overlong PTP text value or reserve and write a terminator with a checked explicit encoded length; test longest accepted property and one-too-long. No matching active finding identified. Source-only, no payload/reproduction. Next: coordinator assigns scoped remediation and regression verification; full evidence/remedy in findings.md (AC-13). No fix or risk acceptance claimed.
